    <div id="tour" hidden
     data-controller="tour"
     data-action="tour:start@window->tour#start"
     data-tour-auto-start-value="true"
     data-tour-complete-url-value="/users/me/tour">
  <div class="tour__scrim" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="tour__card shadow"
       role="dialog"
       aria-modal="true"
       aria-labelledby="tour-title"
       aria-describedby="tour-body"
       data-tour-target="card"
       data-action="keydown->tour#onKeydown">
    <p class="tour__progress" data-tour-target="progress"></p>
    <h2 id="tour-title" class="tour__title" data-tour-target="title"></h2>
    <p id="tour-body" class="tour__body" data-tour-target="body"></p>
    <div class="tour__actions">
      <button type="button" class="btn btn--borderless" data-tour-target="back" data-action="tour#back">Back</button>
      <span class="tour__spacer" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      <button type="button" class="btn btn--borderless" data-tour-target="skip" data-action="tour#skip">Skip tour</button>
      <button type="button" class="btn" data-tour-target="next" data-action="tour#next">Next</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
